objective: Fix the packaged CLI, which could not search, resolve, read news or print an inventory on a machine without the optional Flatpak backend, because the inventory command answered for every command that came after it in the dispatcher.
scope: calix inventory claims only its own command path, so it no longer swallows the commands listed after it
an absent optional Flatpak backend contributes no rows instead of failing the whole inventory document
the service says once per process that the optional backend is missing, so the omission is never silent
the package builds and ships libcalix-flatpak-backend.so.1, the library the loader asks for
the gate builds the backend and checks that the library is there, and the release artifact carries it

defect.how_it_was_found: a live install of calix-gpui-git answered every command after list with FlatpakBackendUnavailable
defect.symptom: calix search standard, calix resolve, calix news and calix inventory all failed with 'Flatpak support is not installed'; calix list standard worked
defect.the_dispatcher_trace: commands/dispatcher.zig -> commands/inventory.zig:22 -> inventory/service.zig:69 -> inventory/service.zig:146 -> flatpak/manager.zig:367 -> flatpak/client.zig:31 -> flatpak/backend_loader.zig:41 -> flatpak/backend_loader.zig:76
defect.root_cause: commands/inventory.zig never compared the invocation's command path, so it built the inventory snapshot and printed it for every command the dispatcher asked after it
defect.second_cause: the inventory service contradicted its own documented contract: 'a backend that is absent contributes nothing rather than failing the whole gathering'
defect.daemon_impact: the daemon serves the same document and answered {"ok":false,"message":"FlatpakBackendUnavailable"} for an inventory request

flatpak_separation_suite.asserts: the CLI has no Flatpak or OSTree dependency, the backend does, its SONAME is ABI 1 and its entry point is exported

live_install.elevation: polkit only; no sudo, su or doas

live_verification.calix search standard --repos: the repository list, not an inventory
live_verification.calix inventory: 1968 packages: ALPM 1881, AUR 17, Flatpak 24, AppImage 16, Cargo 20, NPM 9, Release 1
live_verification.calix search flatpak gimp: flathub results with permissions and sizes
live_verification.user_services: calix-daemon and calix-notify enabled and active

before_and_after.method: a mount namespace that hides /usr/lib/calix, so the optional backend cannot be loaded
before_and_after.v0_2_1_cli: the published v0.2.1 CLI cannot run at all in that state: it dies with SIGILL in the TLS path
before_and_after.fixed_cli: the fixed CLI answers the same commands and says once that the optional backend is missing

known_gaps: The frozen Python engine is still installed as ~/.local/bin/calix, a symlink to scripts/calix, and it shadows the packaged CLI in PATH. The live verification used the absolute path /usr/lib/calix/calix; the name collision is a real footgun and is not fixed here.
The Flatpak ecosystem in the live inventory comes from the machine's own flathub installation, not from a test fixture.
The package was installed from the pushed tree, not from a release tarball; the tarball is not an installer.
